identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.core_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Dark, sleek, data-dense but organized. Glowing accents for AI magic.
identity.emotional_tone: Professional, High-Tech, Trustworthy, Powerful, Edge over the market

headings.usage: Main page titles, section headers, big stats. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

data.usage: Prices, percentages, code snippets, wallet addresses, transaction hashes.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00FF94] text-black hover:bg-[#00CC76] font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,148,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,255,148,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1F1F1F] text-white hover:bg-[#27272A] border border-[#3F3F46] rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-all

inputs.default: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#1F1F1F] focus:border-[#00FF94] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00FF94] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-[#52525B] transition-all

charts.style: Minimalist, no grid lines (or very subtle), gradient fills for area charts, neon strokes for line charts.

strategy_card.style: Tracing Beam style. Dark card with a glowing border that activates on hover. Displays 'Confidence Score' prominently.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, sidebars, and floating overlays. Class: 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10'
visual_enhancers.glows: Use 'shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(157,0,255,0.2)]' for AI elements to give them a 'breathing' feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to prevent banding and add 'film' quality.

transitions.page_load: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

hero_background.usage: Background for Login/Hero sections with low opacity overlay

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Use 'text-[#00FF94]' for positive indicators, 'text-[#FF0055]' for negative.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for dark colors. Use solid dark colors.
DO NOT center align the app container. Use full width.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Ensure 'Chivo' and 'JetBrains Mono' fonts are loaded in index.html or via CSS import.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the dashboard. Use the 'Strategy Card' component for the AI recommendations.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts. Customize the tooltips to be dark and glassmorphic.
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_features: Highlight AI recommendations with the Cyber Purple color (#9D00FF) and subtle glow effects.
instructions_to_main_agent.trading_view: Ensure the trading view is dense but readable. Use the 'Performance Pro' archetype rules.
